classification: Deterministic verification of a fixed-grid active-branch derivative, not a utility/adoption confirmation
requirements: All thirteen declared coordinates are attempted in every profile and mesh
All whole-array discrepancies and branch switches remain recorded
Whole-array error bound applies to every attempted coordinate at both steps, including all changed branches
No switched coordinate is silently counted as passing or removed from raw results
A fixed-branch derivative gate needs every coordinate stable and passing in at least one declared profile/mesh
Every mesh must produce a nonzero admission jump and nonzero tangent jump
Reset interpolation knots and unsupported moving-duration/domain coordinates must reject
Original R18 source Git blob identities must match INPUT_IDENTITIES.json
